div.head: Swer 10
div.ab: On lifiendes Godes naman, swa ic feos bidde, swa ic gywanan hæbbe ðæs, þe me N. behet, ða ic him min sealde.
On lifiendes Godes naman, swa ic feos bidde, swa ic gywanan hæbbe ðæs, ðe me Ñ behet, ða ic him min sealde.
In Dei uiuentis nomine, sic pecuniam exigo, sicut michi minus est de eo, quod N. in conuentione habuit, quando meum N. ei uendidi.
Im Namen des lebendigen Gottes, só forder ich Geld, wie ich dessen [noch] ermangle, was mir N., als ich ihm meines verkaufte, versprochen hat.
In the name of the living God, I demand money just as I [still] lack what N. promised me when I sold him what was mine.
[I swear] in the name of the living God [that] I still lack what N. promised me, and demand payment for what I sold him.
div.note: U: translator unrecorded: check; The Quadripartitus reads ‘mein [Vieh] N.’. In B ‘gy’ of ‘gywanan’ is erased, so ‘wanan’.
